property_summary: For any initialize(...) call, the reference implementation sets the stored useStolenNftOracle state to the boolean passed as _useStolenNftOracle; the mutant incorrectly always sets useStolenNftOracle to true, so there exist inputs where the stored value differs from the provided _useStolenNftOracle (specifically when _useStolenNftOracle == false).
change_summary: Replace assignment of useStolenNftOracle to ignore provided _useStolenNftOracle and always set it to true.
